question: Eight people live on different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 8. Only 4 people live above Aditya. Anu lives on the sixth floor. Only two people live between Anu and Shubham. Ravi lives immediately above Deep. Diksha lives immediately below Sakshi. Sakshi lives on the topmost floor. On which floor does Deep live?
solution:
According to the given information:

1) Anu lives on the sixth floor.

2) Only two people live between Anu and Shubham.
